summary: Improve KPI definitions, variance commentary and management dashboards. Explore this five-day practical course and strengthen your reporting cycle.
lede: Management reporting and KPI dashboard design turn financial and operational results into information for management decisions. The training is for reporting analysts, KPI owners, finance partners and operational managers who prepare or use recurring performance reviews. Learners practise defining KPIs and thresholds, analysing variances, shaping Excel dashboard views with IBCS-informed conventions, and tracking actions linked to forecast gaps.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who prepare, validate, interpret or act on recurring KPI reports and management dashboards. It is designed for intermediate learners with experience using business performance information.
audience: Department Heads using management dashboards to prioritise
prerequisites: Prior experience preparing, reviewing or using business performance reports is recommended. Working knowledge of spreadsheets and basic financial or operational KPIs will help you complete the exercises. No coding or programming is required.
